We chose this hotel due to its location halfway between the city and the airport, The hotel was modern and clean and I found the staff very friendly and helpful (and they spoke English). The room was small and we had wifi in our room Food was good and the restaurant staff was very attentive. Other than the out of the way location I would definitely recommend. Wanted to stay at a hotel whichever gives us convenience to move fromto the Casablanca International Airport. Having read reviews I booked one-night stay through its hotel website. We took 40 min train ride from the basement of the airport to the Casa Voyager Station (60 MD per person for 1st class ticket Highly recommendable as you may not find a place to put your luggage in the 2nd class car) and arrived at the hotel located just outside of the station. Room is quite functional quite comfortable. Breakfast was simple Wi-Fi connection is only available on the groud floor, There are few eateries near the station. so we again took a train back to the airport. If you are looking for convenient and functional place to stay for a night
Not the best hotel ever, convenient for the airport (15 mins drive) Good value especially if booked in advance and the breakfast Staff were friendly.

I arrived late a night at the hotel and the receptionist was verry helpfull. If this were a 300-400Dh a night room this would be a 2-star review. I could understand the cockroaches in a big city and how the hotel is a bit dirty around the edges I would be more appreciative of the wifi and would excuse the smoking in the lobby Madrid and on better places and those are much more pleasant cities with a lot more to offer and better infrastructure for business and tourism.

passing through Casablanca to get to Marrakesh. Hotel moved to the other side of the train station smaller compact building smaller rooms and very compact service is slow too many employees roaming around one only at the reception the quality of service and food we used to enjoy when staying in this particular Ibis in the past has been degraded the room too small for two people and the comfort is lacking in simple things like the absence of an iron and an iron board one soap two shampoos and two towels for two people. The front office manager name is Ahmed Rafike he speaks excellent English. There were two ladies who work the front desk who also speak good English I forgot their names.
